sub_answers.text: Kathleen Buckley won Ashbourne Cup medals with University College Cork in 1936 and 1937 [d28262014s1p0]. She also won multiple All-Ireland senior medals and captained Cork to an All-Ireland in 1941, showing progression from university to inter-county success [d28262014s0p0]. She was a prolific goalscorer for both club and county, scoring in Ashbourne Cup seasons and in All-Ireland finals, indicating university-level play coincided with high-level inter-county performance [d28262014s1p0].

sub_answers.text: UCC (University College Cork) won Ashbourne Cup medals in 1936 and 1937 with Kathleen Buckley as a team member [d28262014s1p0]. Kathleen 'Kitty' Buckley was a prolific goalscorer for club and county in the same period, scoring multiple goals in championship matches in the late 1930s and early 1940s, marking her as a notable player associated with those Ashbourne Cup successes [d28262014s1p0] [d28262014s0p0].
